parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure that the value is unique among different requests. **ClientToken** supports only ASCII characters.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
Specifies whether a next query token is available. Valid values:

- If this is the first query or no next query is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

- If a next query is available, set the value to the **NextToken** value returned in the previous API call.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the resource. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~120468~~) operation to query the region ID.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The list of resource IDs. You can specify up to 50 resource IDs.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The resource type. Valid values:

- **vpcendpoint**: endpoint.                                

- **vpcendpointservice**: endpoint service.
